title: Mystic Apothecary Sorceress
description: A bald female sorceress in a flowing green cloak stands behind a purple apothecary counter, holding a glowing golden ring. She is surrounded by shelves filled with glowing potions, magical herbs, scrolls, and an open spellbook with glowing runes, while a floating crystal ball displays a miniature city scene.
prompt: A bald female sorceress with glowing white eyes wearing a deep green hooded cloak stands in a magical apothecary shop with purple wooden shelves. She holds a glowing golden ring in one hand while an open spellbook with glowing pink runes rests on the counter. The shelves are filled with glass potion bottles, scrolls, herbs, and magical ingredients. A large crystal ball floating nearby shows a detailed miniature city inside. Arched window with glowing light, blue bubbles and red ribbons floating in the air, rich fantasy detail, cinematic lighting.
